caption: A New Chapter Begins Official Launch of Shivani Sharma Foundation 🦋 ​“Small Step, Big Impact” This philosophy is at the core of everything we do. Yesterday marked the grand official launch of the Shivani Sharma Foundation, standing united on stage with our leadership, team, dedicated volunteers, and promising young students holding their new laptops. ​This event was more than just a celebration; it was a firm commitment to long-term social change, digital literacy, and community welfare. Through our drive, we equipped 50 young minds with laptops for their digital education and provided sports clothes to promote holistic development among children. ​We are also thrilled to announce that our official website is now live! 🌐 www.shivanisharmafoundation.org This platform will serve as a bridge between our ground-level initiatives and supporters nationwide who wish to join hands in making a difference. ​Seeing the bright, excited faces of our students on stage surrounded by our hard-working team reminded us why ground-level action matters so much. Every laptop given represents a doorway to endless learning, self-reliance, and a brighter tomorrow. ​This launch is just the beginning of a long journey to educate, empower, and elevate lives. We extend our deepest gratitude to everyone who attended, supported, and believed in our vision. Together, we are creating a movement where no child is left behind. ​#ShivaniSharmaFoundation #OfficialFoundationLaunch #WebsiteLaunch #SmallStepBigImpact #NewBeginnings

Empowering the Future | Laptop Distribution Ceremony 💻 ​A proud and deeply meaningful day for the “Shivanisharma Foundation” We successfully launched our official website (www.shivanisharmafoundation.org) and distributed 50 laptops to deserving students under our ‘Shaping Tomorrows’ initiative. ​We were deeply honoured by the presence of Hon. Shri Sachin Bhau Ahir (Deputy Speaker, Maharashtra Legislative Council), Aishwarya Sangeeta Sachin Ahir, Amit Tiwari, and other esteemed dignitaries who joined us to empower our youth. ​Empowering students with technology isn’t just about providing laptops—it’s about bridging the digital divide and creating equal opportunities. Together for a digitally empowered future! 🌐 ​Yesterday was a major milestone for the Shivani Sharma Foundation. Along with launching our official website, we distributed 50 laptops to bright, young minds to support their higher education and digital skills. ​A heartfelt thank you to Hon. Shri Sachin Bhau Ahir sir and all our distinguished guests for gracing the event and encouraging our mission. ​Explore our work and join the movement at www.shivanisharmafoundation.org ​ShivaniSharmaFoundation DigitalIndia YouthEmpowerment TechForGood NGOInitiative ShapingTomorrows ​#ShivaniSharmaFoundation #OfficialLaunch #LaptopDistribution #DigitalEducation #smallstepsbigimpact

🌟 *Heartiest Welcome & Best Wishes* *Shivani Sharma Foundation* is honoured to welcome *Hon’ble Shri Sunil Ahir Ji, Best Bus Committee Member & Former Corporator, BMC*, as the *Chief Guest* for its inaugural initiative dedicated to empowering deserving students through the distribution of *50 laptops*, aimed at supporting education and building a brighter future. A respected public representative, dedicated social worker, and committed leader, *Hon’ble Shri Sunil Ahir Ji* has consistently contributed towards public welfare, civic development, and community upliftment. His continuous efforts in strengthening urban infrastructure and supporting citizen-centric initiatives have made a meaningful impact in society. We are privileged to have him grace this occasion and share his valuable thoughts and guidance with an esteemed gathering of students, educators, social leaders, entrepreneurs, and changemakers committed to empowering youth through education and creating meaningful opportunities for a brighter future 📍 *9th August 2026 | 2:00 PM* 📍*Ravindra Natya Mandir 5th Floor, Auditorium (Karishma)Near Siddhivinayak Mandir Prabhadevi, Mumbai* *With Warm Regards,* *Shivani Sharma Foundation* *Together, let us empower education, inspire young minds, and build a brighter future for the next generation.*
